verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The actual turn-based map, units and turn UI were visible, but the Move a unit tutorial guide remained over the play surface in the candidate game-entry and input captures.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: Because the tutorial overlay was still present, GAME_ENTRY is not promoted for this run even though the underlying map rendered.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: A bounded pan changed the visible map framing and a tap produced movement-target feedback while the tutorial guide remained visible.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves input response only. It does not satisfy the unobstructed GAME_ENTRY gate.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The Unciv package remained alive after the observed interactions with no captured FATAL EXCEPTION, native SIGABRT/SIGSEGV or ANR marker in the validation window.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves process survival and captured-window crash absence only.

distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.lesson: A rendered strategy map underneath an instructional overlay is still an onboarding state when the evidence rule requires an unobstructed playable screen.
distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox mobile verification, require the actual controllable play surface without blocking onboarding overlays before promoting GAME_ENTRY.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: The Move a unit tutorial guide persisted through map pan and tap probes, so the earlier positive promotion was too early.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: Complete or dismiss the observed tutorial task, recapture a clean play screen, then verify input-caused state change before promotion.

allowed: partial input-response observation while promotion remains blocked
stillForbidden: promoting this Unciv run as a positive training sample
